# Boot Handle Requirements Checklist: Shared apps/api integration boot helper

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the shared boot handle and its safe teardown
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`; reviewer-owned. `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied, not that implementation is done. A struck item (~~text~~) does not apply, with the reason after it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the stages `stop()` must handle (nothing started, store started, app created, app started) all named with what each owes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, US2]
- [x] CHK002 Is the teardown's behaviour defined when `stop()` is called twice or after a successful stop? [Gap, Spec §FR-002] — added to FR-002: a second `stop()` is harmless.
- [x] CHK003 Is the behaviour defined when `stop()` runs for a boot that never reached the turn? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are the environment values the helper uses stated, and is inventing new ones excluded? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK005 Is the file-level teardown requirement for `bootstrap.integration.spec.ts` stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "as production configures it" bounded by an explicit list of what the boot does? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is "safe teardown" defined as attempt every close, release the turn in a `finally`, rethrow the first error? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is "the boot sequence exists once" defined by named calls so it can be searched? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is the turn being "free" quantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — a fresh take resolves within 1 s.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do FR-003 (suites never close app/store/turn) and the sign-up suite's own seeding and restores agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK011 Do FR-004 (no unused option) and the sign-up suite's pre-start environment and spy agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, US1-3]
- [x] CHK012 Does the teardown order app, store, turn agree between FR-002, US2-3 and the Assumptions? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK013 Is the Spec Delta consistent with which FRs are lasting (FR-001, 002, 005) versus scope rules? [Consistency, Spec §Spec Delta]

## Scenario and Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are failures at each boot stage and a throwing close covered as scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK015 Is the case of two suites in one run addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is a failing turn take (database unreachable) addressed? [Gap] — covered by stage "before the turn was taken"/"boot threw before the app started" (Edge Cases, US2-1); stop() releases regardless.

## Non-Functional, Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK017 Is "no behaviour change to the API" stated with what must not move? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK018 Is the mutation-run treatment of the helper left to the plan explicitly, and decided there? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan R4]
- [x] CHK019 Is the dependency on `@motor-fix/domain/testing` and the libs-never-import-apps rule documented? [Dependency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK020 Is there a requirement-ID scheme tying FRs to SCs and acceptance scenarios? [Traceability, Spec §FR, SC, Spec Delta]
